tasks.title: Copy tests.yaml
tasks.description: Copy tests.yaml from the context directory to the test workspace. This file is required to run the parameterized suite later.

tasks.title: Scaffold Package Initializer
tasks.description: Scaffold the main package initializer. This creates the primary module declaration for whenwords.

tasks.title: Implement Utility Math & Date Normalization
tasks.description: Implement utility logic in utils.py. This includes a robust half-up rounding function (e.g. 2.5 rounds to 3) and a timestamp normalization helper that converts Unix seconds (int/float), ISO 8601 strings, and datetime.datetime objects into standard UTC float epoch timestamps. Naive datetimes and ISO strings should be treated as UTC.

tasks.title: Implement Duration Formatter
tasks.description: Implement the core duration formatting logic in duration.py. Handles positive numbers of seconds, conversion, plurals, verbose and compact styles, max_units truncation, negative/NaN/Inf validations, and unit cascade rules (e.g. 12 months -> 1 year). For the rounding of the smallest displayed unit and cascade rules, follow standard half-up comparison.

tasks.title: Implement Timeago Relative Formatter
tasks.description: Implement raw timeago formatting logic in timeago.py. Normalizes both the target timestamp and the reference timestamp, calculates the difference, and formats it as relative time (e.g. '3 hours ago' or 'in 5 minutes') based on unit thresholds. Invalid formats raise a ValueError.

tasks.title: Implement Duration Parser
tasks.description: Implement parse_duration in parser.py. Handles translation of human-written duration strings (compact, verbose with 'and', decimal, colon notation) into float or integer seconds. Case-insensitively parses unit aliases. Negative values, empty strings, bare numbers, or parseable unit failures raise ValueError. Parse colon inputs like '2:30' (h:mm) or '2:30:00' (h:mm:ss) robustly.

tasks.title: Expose Main Relative Time APIs
tasks.description: Create relative.py which exposes timeago, duration, and parse_duration functions by importing them from their respective module coordinates as specified by the module interface.

tasks.title: Implement Relative Time Tests
tasks.description: Create test_relative.py to load, parse, and drive the YAML-based test suite defined in tests.yaml using pytest. Verify complete compliance of all formatter, parser, and relative time-ago operations.
